# PR #2039: Patch: Stinkyscape S03, Starship Pieces on existing keywords

Closes #1860

## What changed and why

This branch implements issue #1860: scripts for 20 Stinkyscape S03 Starship Piece cards built on existing keywords behind R1420's gate, plus the two engine capabilities the part needed and ten rulings for decisions the spec does not make.

**Card scripts** (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/cNNN_*.rs`, each with base and Radiant tests in the same file):

- Hook/activated Death and trigger cards: #38 Shield Amplifier (`after_attack`/`after_attacked` buff when the attacker survives), #40 Poison Capsule (Cry places plague tokens, end-of-turn damage to all enemies), #43 Healing Capsule (end-of-turn heal to hero and own Units), #49 Spacemine (Death deals its attack as damage to distinct random enemies), #93 Patcher Nanobots (Death heals hero), #107 RR-5000 (start-of-turn self buff), #132 Defensive Crystal (Death grants hero Armor), #134 Felinor Containment Chamber (Death summons a Felinor token with the chamber's stats; Radiant doubled with Divine Shield), #158 Stratos Swarm (Cry fills the board with Startos; Radiant summons Radiant copies), #175 Frost Module (Activate: Freeze an enemy Unit; once a turn base, twice Radiant).
- Keywords-only cards (empty `Script::default()`, stats/keywords as catalog data, documented headers plus tests): #48 Ultralight Chassis, #68 Startos, #69 Falcon (Radiant face 8/2, stats doubled per the designer's answer), #72 Paragon Mk1, #73 Paragon Mk2, #98 Hull Booster, #100 AP Rounds, #101 Overdrive Module, #108 Trila 3, #122 Vamp Rounds.

**Engine** (each with its test, per `crates/cards/README.md`):

- `crates/engine/src/effects/split.rs`: new `damage_random_enemies` verb (one damage instance each to N different random standing enemies; fewer when fewer stand; nothing at 0). `damage_split` was rejected because it can hit the same target twice.
- `crates/engine/src/effects/summon.rs`: new `SummonArgs.keywords` rider granting keywords to a fresh summon as it lands (a `TargetSpec` cannot name a just-created card). Granted through the public `grantKeyword` effect rather than a private helper, which does not exist publicly.
- Tests: `r1860004` cases in `crates/engine/tests/rules/effects_split.rs`, `r1860007` cases in `crates/engine/tests/rules/effects_summon.rs`.

**Rulings**: `spec/rulings/R1860000.md`–`R1860009.md` (block ST-S03-1…10 in order), block paragraph in `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` regenerated via `cargo jackioh spec index`. Catalog `loc` refreshed for the 20 entries; no pending fragment, no golden-trace move, shipped totals unchanged, set still held by R1420's gate. No §8.10, §7, BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, or catalog row needed correction: all params and texts matched the ST13 rows.

## How it was tested

- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c175_frost_module`: 5/5 pass.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok (1271 rulings, 2897 proofs).
- `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh patches check`: both ok.
- Earlier passes ran the per-file card tests, both engine verb suites, and `fmt`; the full gates (workspace clippy, workspace tests, fuzz 200, web suites) run in CI on the pull request.

## Decisions made

- Distinct-enemy damage as a new engine verb rather than reusing `damage_split` (double-hit violates ST-S03-5).
- Summon-time keyword rider rather than a follow-up grant (no `TargetSpec` can name a just-created card).
- Defender-survival detection via `SELF_KEY` absence rather than a new engine fact (smallest change; R89 documents the key).
- Test boards are aura-free so `unit_view` attack reads are exact; played attackers without Charge/Rush wait a full round (summoning sickness) while setup-field units act at once.

## Findings

- **Blocking** (`c175_frost_module.rs:67`, unused `ANCHOR` const fails clippy): held. The constant was declared once and used nowhere (tests use `FILLER`). Fixed by deleting that one line; clippy is now clean. The working tree holds only this one-line deletion on top of the branch's commits.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 3 of 3.

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 150.0 min | green | changes (1 blocking) |
| 2 | fix, 1.5 min | green | changes (1 blocking) |
| 3 | fix, 29.5 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 9s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |

</details>

---
Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40413955474)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bot-journal/1860.md). Radiant clones base; all numbers via `param`. Copy `classic/c013_boots_on_the_ground.rs` and `meditative/c049_3_ai_girlfriend.rs`.
5. `c040`: Cry `place_plague_tokens({"count": param("counters")})` (copy `classic/c061_plague_bringer_goliath.rs`); end of turn `damage_all({"side": "enemy", "heroes": true, "amount": plague_on_self * param("damage")})`, `vec![]` at 0 counters; read counters off `ctx.self_` (`classicplus/c003_second_amendment_snake.rs` `hits()`).
6. `c043`: end of turn `heal` selfHero plus `for_each_card` over own side healing each Unit, both `param("heal")`; copy `classicplus/c019_4_support_loser.rs` verbatim including `cards_in_scope`.
7. `c049`: Death reads `unit_view(ctx.state, &snapshot).attack` (buffs included, R89; `classicplus/c012_1_devour.rs` precedent); 0 → `vec![]`; else new verb `{"count": param("targets"), "amount": attack}`. Radiant clones base.
8. `c093`: Death `heal({"target": {"of": "selfHero"}, "amount": param("heal")})`. `c107`: start of turn `buff` self `+param("attackGain")`. `c132`: Death `gain_hero_armor({"amount": param("heroArmor")})`.
9. `c134`: Death reads `unit_view` attack and `max_health` of the `ctx.self_` snapshot; `summon({"defId": crate::card_def("core-t-felinor").id, "player": "self", "statsOverride": {attack, health}})` (copy `meditative/c094_shrinking_felinor.rs` + `core/c062_friend_of_felinors.rs`); Radiant doubles both and adds `"keywords": [{"kind": "Divine Shield"}]` (step 3 rider). Summon lands before this card's own fuse into the Dormant Starship (engine order, R1852000).
10. `c158`: `cry` `fill_board({"defId": crate::card_def("stinkyscape-068").id})`, Radiant adds `"radiant": true` (copy `core/c062_friend_of_felinors.rs`; a Spell's resolve hangs off `cry`, `core/c005_stockpile.rs`).
11. `c175`: one `ActivationDecl`, `uses: Count(1)` base / `Count(2)` Radiant (copy `meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs`), `targets: [TargetDecl enemy Unit]` (`classic/c012_book_of_blood.rs` filter shape with `"side": "enemy"`), run `freeze({"target": {"of": "chosen"}})`.
12. The ten keywords-only files: keep `Script::default()` both faces (Radiant stats/keywords are catalog data), replace the `STUB (#1857)` header with the card's doc comment citing its §8.10 row and BUILD row, noting Equip (R1086/R1852001) and fuse (R1852000) are engine behavior.
13. Tests live in each file (`mod tests`, `crate::scenario`, guard `let _preview = preview_sets(&[SetName::Stinkyscape]);` first). Name every ruling-proving test `r18600NN_…` and cite its R number in the file header. Equip plays use `s.play(ID, json!({"zone": lane, "equip": true}))` (`core/c056_jilliax.rs`).
14. Write the ten notes `spec/rulings/R1860000.md`–`R1860009.md` (front matter `id/title/cards/proven_in`, `[[R…]]`/`[[§…]]` links; copy `spec/rulings/R1852001.md`): R1860000←ST-S03-1 … R1860009←ST-S03-10 in order. Add the block paragraph to `spec/11-rulings.md`. Run `cargo jackioh spec index`, then `spec check`.
15. Refresh `loc` for the 20 catalog entries with `cargo jackioh catalog loc <script path>`; nothing else in `catalog.json`. Run `catalog check` and `patches check`.
16. Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, the touched card tests, the engine rules tests for the two verbs, and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`.

## Tests

- `crates/engine/tests/rules/effects_split.rs`: `r1860004_…` — count 2 hits two different enemies; one standing takes one; 0 amount nothing.
- `crates/engine/tests/rules/effects_summon.rs`: `r1860007_…` — summoned token gains the rider keyword; without rider nothing granted.
- Per file (each: base behavior, Radiant behavior, death fuses a copy into `stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship` where the BUILD row says so): `c038`: `r1860000_…` attacker-survives buffs / defender-survives (Divine Shield absorbing) buffs / dies nothing / Cleave splash nothing / equip host gains text and Divine Shield. `c040`: `r1860001_…` prompt places 2 on one named permanent; `r1860002_…` end-of-turn single hit of counters × 1 per enemy, none at 0, foreign counters ignored. `c043`: `r1860003_…` hero past 30 plus each own Unit incl. self, enemies untouched. `c049`: `r1860004_…` damage equals buffed attack at death, 0 attack nothing, Radiant two different enemies (one when one stands). `c068/69/72/73`: no new ruling; Ranged/Charge/Flying/Pierce/Divine Shield per BUILD rows, Radiant faces. `c093`: hero +6/+12 past 30. `c098/100/101/122`: Armor reduction / Pierce ignores Armor / Brittle crumbles + Reborn at 1 / Lifesteal heals; equip passes stats and keywords, piece-into-non-piece stays no piece (R1852001). `c107`: `r1860005_…` +4 lasting, stacks. `c108`: Windfury two attacks; Radiant Rush. `c132`: `r1860006_…` +1/+2 hero Armor. `c134`: `r1860007_…` token stats equal buffed attack and max health, leftmost open zone, full board none; Radiant doubled with Divine Shield. `c158`: `r1860008_…` fills open zones with Startos, Dormant zone skipped, full board none; Radiant summons Radiant. `c175`: `r1860009_…` enemy Unit Frozen, hero unpickable, once per turn base / twice Radiant, equipped host takes the Activate.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c038_shield_amplifier` (one per file), `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules effects_split`, same for `effects_summon`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --features jackioh-engine/testkit` for cross-card checks if touched, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`.

## Done when

- [ ] All 20 scripts return only prelude-verb effects; keywords-only files stay empty with tests.
- [ ] New engine verb + summon rider each have engine tests; no other engine file changed.
- [ ] R1860000–R1860009 notes exist, `proven_in` names files holding `r18600NN` tests, `spec index` clean, `spec check` green.

- [ ] Set still gated: no fragment, no golden-trace move, shipped totals unchanged.
- [ ] `fmt --check`, clippy on both crates, all named tests, and fuzz 200 seeds green.

## Risks

- `unit_view` on a death snapshot also sees field auras; tests use aura-free boards so the read is exact, and auras applying mid-combat are engine behavior either way.
- `SELF_KEY`-absence as "defender survived" relies on `run_after_attacked` inserting it only on death (R89); the Cleave-splash and died-attacking cases in the tests pin both sides.
- The summon keywords rider touches a shared struct but only adds an optional field; existing summons are unaffected (default `None`), covered by the untouched summon suites.
- ` preview_sets` guard is per-thread: keep one guard alive per test; never share across tests.

None blocking.
